source_notes.note: Finding vocabulary is scoped to small bowel; esophageal, gastric and colonic findings refer to MST.
Quality uses three equal small-bowel transit-time segments; this is not a measured image-level label.
Bleeding potential is an interpreter probability assessment, not observed bleeding.
Nodule is described as generally round, 2-3 mm, without a clearly demarcated base; distinct from nodular mucosa. This definition supplies no measurement of a dataset observation.
Certainty values are retained verbatim, including Exclusion of and Follow-up of; no status is asserted for a dataset image.
